document_contents.quote: On examination of monthly returns, the following defects were noticed: i) Under declaration of output tax ii) Excess claim of ITC
The grievance of the petitioner is that the impugned order records that further opportunity of hearing cannot be granted.

defects_argued.quote: It is the case of the petitioner that no personal hearing opportunity was ever granted to the petitioner, the impugned order thus suffers from the vice of violation of principles of natural justice.

outcome.quote: In view thereof, the impugned order dated 28.04.2024 is set aside.
